title: Polynomial-length prefix language in NP
statement: Let $C,c$ be natural numbers and let $V$ be a language in $\mathsf{P}$. Then the language of binary strings $q$ for which there is a binary string $s$ such that the marker-removed second component of $q$, followed by $s$, has length $C(|x|+1)^c$, where $x$ is the first component of $q$, and the pair encoding of $x$ with this concatenation belongs to $V$, is in $\mathsf{NP}$.
